verses.en: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.sm: Koru. Le ALII e, ua e fiafia lava i lou nuu; 4a e faafoisia mai le tafeaga o Iakopo.

verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.sm: Ua e faamagaloina le amio leaga a lou nuu, ua e ufitia a latou agasala uma lava. Sela.

verses.en: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.sm: Oa e ayeesea lou ma‘ema‘eà uma lava; ua e liliu ese lou toasa mamafa.

verses.en: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, o lo matou faaolataga, ia e faafoisia mai i matou; ia e faamavae atu foi lou toatamai ia te i matou.

verses.en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.sm: E faavavau ea lou toasa ia te i matou? e te faaualoa ea lou ma'ema'eá e au tupulaga?

verses.en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.sm: ete le toe faaolaola mai ea ia te i matou; ina ia fiafia lava lou nuu ia te oe?

verses.en: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ia e faailoa mai ia te i matou lou alofa; ia E foaiina mai foi ia te i matou le olataga mai ia te oe.

verses.en: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.sm: Ou te faalogologo atu i mea e fetalaia mai e le ALII le Atua; auē. na te fetalai mai ia manuia lona nuu atoa ma ona tagata amio Atua; a e aua neʻi latou toe liliu atu i le valea.

verses.en: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.sm: E moni, ua latalata lana olataga i e ua matatau ia te ia; ina ia tumau ai le mamalu i lo tatou nuu.

verses.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.sm: to O le alofa ma le faamaoni ua la fetaiai; o le amiotonu ma le filemu ua la feasogi.

verses.en: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.sm: E tupu ae le faamaoni ai le lalolagi; e vaavaai ifo foi le amiotonu mai le lagi.

verses.en: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.sm: E foaiina mai e le ALII lava le manuia; e fua mai foi e lo tatou laueleele ona lava fua.

verses.en: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.sm: E muamua atu i ona luma le amiotonu; na te faatumauina foi ona vae i le ala. 11 12 13 14
